transcript: Client wants a membership website with member email notifications, member import from CSV, and a custom integration with Salesforce. They want an admin dashboard. Budget is limited and launch target is six weeks.
Client needs a course directory website, instructor profiles, a contact form, and weekly email updates. They also ask whether student progress reports can be exported to CSV.
Client wants agent profiles, property listings, a search page, and a custom connection to their existing CRM. They request a launch in four weeks and ask for an estimate.
Follow-up: remove Salesforce integration from the initial launch. Add SMS notifications instead of email notifications. Keep member CSV import and admin dashboard. Launch date remains six weeks.
